author: GitHub
description:
Managing community feedback does not have to be a full-time manual chore. See how we use GitHub Copilot app to constantly monitor multiple communication streams and repository boards at once. With a simple prompt, you can tell your agent to refresh your repository and watch it sort everything into actionable tasks.
